EDGE-CLIENT-SUBMIT-QUERY.security_assumption: Query parsing and schema validation required. Operation type must be checked (signing, compiling, mining operations denied). Input scalar types (Bytes32, Address, BigInt) must be format-validated. No built-in auth - external access control assumed.

EDGE-CLIENT-SUBMIT-MUTATION.security_assumption: RLP-encoded transaction must be decoded and fully validated before broadcast. Same validation as JSON-RPC transaction submission.

EDGE-DNS-RESPONSE.security_assumption: Root record signature must be verified against known secp256k1 public key. Sequence number must be >= cached value (anti-rollback). Branch content must match subdomain hash (keccak256). Multiple independent DNS sources should be used to mitigate eclipse attacks.

EDGE-BEACON-PROPOSES.security_assumption: JWT authentication verifies channel identity. Execution payload content must be fully validated: deprecated PoW fields (difficulty=0, nonce=0, ommers empty, mixHash=0), state root, transaction execution. Fork choice state (head, safe, finalized hashes) must reference known valid blocks.

EDGE-MINER-SUBMITS-BLOCK.security_assumption: Full PoW validation: difficulty target verification, total difficulty computation against TTD, ethash proof verification. Blocks claiming to reach TTD must be carefully validated to prevent premature or malicious merge triggering.

EDGE-BUILDER-BID-BROADCAST.security_assumption: Builder BLS signature must be verified against registered builder_index. Builder must have sufficient excess balance for bid value. execution_payment must equal zero for gossip bids. parent_block_hash and parent_block_root must reference valid chain state. Slot must be current or next.

EDGE-BUILDER-ENVELOPE-BROADCAST.security_assumption: Envelope must match previously accepted bid (block_hash). Builder signature must be verified. State root must be correct (computed from process_execution_payload). Payload content must pass full EL validation.

EDGE-BUILDER-DEPOSIT.security_assumption: Withdrawal credentials must have BUILDER_WITHDRAWAL_PREFIX (0x03). Address format must be validated. Deposit amount must meet minimum requirements.

EDGE-DAPP-ASSET-QUERY.security_assumption: Address parameter must be valid Ethereum format. ChainId, limit, and asset types must be validated. User consent must be obtained before returning asset data. Only whitelisted assets should be shared. dApp identity should be verified to prevent phishing.

EDGE-USER-SUBMIT.security_assumption: Conversion must correctly map gas_price to both max_fee_per_gas and max_priority_fee_per_gas. Access list must be preserved unchanged. Chain ID must be maintained. Type field updated from 0x1 to 0x2. Incorrect conversion could alter transaction economics.

EDGE-PEER-TX-ANNOUNCE.security_assumption: Validate devp2p packet size (10MB limit), hash count limits (4096 for announcements, 256 for requests), transaction content matches announced hashes, blob sidecar KZG proof verification.

EDGE-PEER-FORK-ID.target_component_interface: ENR fork ID field and eth handshake fork ID exchange
EDGE-PEER-FORK-ID.security_assumption: Fork ID is not cryptographically authenticated. Validation uses CRC32 comparison and subset/superset relationship checks. Malicious peers can lie about fork ID; this is a best-effort filter, not a security boundary.

EDGE-EL-ENGINE-API-REQUESTS.target_component_interface: Engine API GetPayloadResponse (execution_requests: deposits, withdrawals, consolidations)
EDGE-EL-ENGINE-API-REQUESTS.security_assumption: JWT-authenticated channel, but CL must validate: execution request type ordering (ascending, no duplicates), per-payload request limits, deserialization correctness. Withdrawal root in payload must match hash_tree_root of expected withdrawals from get_expected_withdrawals. Parent hash, prev_randao, and timestamp consistency required.

EDGE-VALIDATOR-BLS-CHANGE.security_assumption: Must verify: validator index exists, current withdrawal credentials use 0x00 BLS prefix, BLS pubkey hash matches credential bytes 1-31, BLS signature is valid using fork-agnostic DOMAIN_BLS_TO_EXECUTION_CHANGE. This is an irreversible one-way credential migration.

EDGE-LC-UPDATE.security_assumption: Must resolve fork-appropriate generalized indices (Altair vs Electra) based on attested slot epoch. Verify finalized root Merkle branch and sync committee Merkle branch using resolved gindices. Validate sync committee BLS aggregate signature. Fork-specific execution payload header hashing (Capella/Deneb/Electra) for backward compatibility.

EDGE-DATA-COLUMN-SIDECAR.target_component_interface: P2P DataColumnSidecar gossip (cells and KZG proofs)
EDGE-DATA-COLUMN-SIDECAR.security_assumption: Batch verify cell KZG proofs using Fiat-Shamir challenge derivation and BLS12-381 pairing check. Deduplicate commitments for efficiency. If batch verification fails, must perform individual cell verification to identify invalid proofs. Recovery requires at least 50% valid cells; corrupted cells must be excluded before recovery attempt.

EDGE-PRECOMPILE-CALL.target_component_interface: CALL to precompile addresses (0x02 SHA256, 0x04 Identity)
EDGE-PRECOMPILE-CALL.security_assumption: Gas metering must accurately reflect computation cost. Identity: base + per-word. SHA256: base + per-word. Arbitrary input size bounded only by gas. No content validation needed (precompiles are pure functions).

EDGE-BLOB-TX-SUBMIT.security_assumption: Must validate VersionedHash format, KZG commitment integrity, blob gas pricing, and all standard transaction validation. Blob count limits must be enforced.

EDGE-BLOCK-PRODUCER-P2P.target_component_interface: P2P block reception / Engine API newPayload
EDGE-BLOCK-PRODUCER-P2P.security_assumption: Full block validation: header validity (parent hash, gas limits, base fee calculation), transaction list integrity, state root verification after applying all transactions, withdrawal processing, request aggregation (deposits, withdrawals, consolidations).

EDGE-CL-ENGINE-API.security_assumption: JWT authentication verified. Payload content must still be validated: execution payload structure, block hash consistency, state transition correctness. Paris merge constraints enforced (difficulty=0, nonce=0, empty ommers).

EDGE-CL-VALIDATOR-GOSSIP.security_assumption: Validate proposer signature, slot assignment, attestation validity, slashing conditions. Reject duplicate or conflicting attestations.

EDGE-P2P-SSZ-GOSSIP.security_assumption: Validate SSZ container structure per EIP-7688 ProgressiveContainer rules. Verify stable generalized indices, active field bitmask, and merkle proof consistency across fork transitions.

EDGE-OFFCHAIN-PROOF-VERIFY.security_assumption: Proof verification must handle ProgressiveContainer generalized indices correctly. Edge cases in container migration (active fields vs inactive fields) must not produce invalid proofs.

EDGE-ONCHAIN-PROOF-VERIFY.target_component_interface: On-chain SSZ merkle proof verification (EVM call)
EDGE-ONCHAIN-PROOF-VERIFY.security_assumption: Smart contract must receive valid proof data. Generalized indices must remain stable across forks per EIP-7688. Malformed proof inputs must not cause EVM execution anomalies.

EDGE-WALLET-INJECT.security_assumption: Provider registration must validate provider object structure. SVG icon data must be sanitized to prevent XSS. Object.freeze must be applied to prevent provider list tampering.

EDGE-DAPP-USER-INTERACT.target_component_interface: EIP-5749 wallet discovery and selection API
EDGE-DAPP-USER-INTERACT.security_assumption: User wallet selection must be validated. DApp must not be able to override user preference or inject fake providers.

EDGE-HW-WALLET-SIGN.security_assumption: Hardware wallet must correctly interpret EIP-7688 ProgressiveContainer format. Signed data must match expected container hash. Migration from one container version to another must not break signing compatibility.

EDGE-PEER-P2P-DEVP2P.security_assumption: All blocks and transactions received via P2P must be fully validated. Eclipse attack mitigations required. Peer reputation scoring should limit impact of malicious peers.

EDGE-MEV-RELAY-BUILDER.security_assumption: Block bids from relays must be validated for correctness. Relay-provided execution payloads must pass full EL validation before inclusion. Censorship resistance mechanisms should be considered.

EDGE-RECV-COMMITTEE-CHECK.target_component_interface: Inclusion List Validation Pipeline (committee membership, committee root, BLS signature)
EDGE-RECV-COMMITTEE-CHECK.security_assumption: All three validation checks must pass: (1) submitter is a member of the inclusion list committee for the specified slot, (2) inclusion_list_committee_root matches the Merkle root of the actual committee, (3) BLS signature is valid under DOMAIN_INCLUSION_LIST_COMMITTEE.

EDGE-ILS-TO-PRODUCER.security_assumption: Block proposals must be validated for inclusion list compliance. Non-compliant blocks (missing forced transactions) must be deprioritized by fork choice. The union of all valid inclusion list transactions must be checked.

EDGE-DEPLOY-REQUEST.target_component_interface: EOF Container Validation (magic bytes, version, section order, type section, code sections, size limits, stray bytes)
EDGE-DEPLOY-REQUEST.security_assumption: Full EOF container validation is required at deployment time: magic byte check, version validation, section order enforcement, type section size divisibility, code section minimum size, MAX_INITCODE_SIZE limit, and no stray bytes. Legacy bytecode must also undergo jump destination analysis.

EDGE-CALL-RECEIVED.target_component_interface: EVM Execution Context (message call handler, jump destination validation)
EDGE-CALL-RECEIVED.security_assumption: All call data and target addresses are untrusted. Jump targets must be validated against pre-computed valid_jump_destinations set. EOF opcode restrictions must be enforced (reject list). DELEGATECALL from EOF to legacy must fail. Invalid opcodes must cause execution revert.

EDGE-PEER-SUBMIT-SYNC.security_assumption: Full validation pipeline required: (1) slot matches current slot within MAXIMUM_GOSSIP_CLOCK_DISPARITY, (2) validator belongs to the sync committee subnet, (3) no duplicate message from this validator for this slot on this subnet, (4) BLS signature over beacon block root is valid.

EDGE-RECV-CONTRIB.security_assumption: Full contribution validation required: slot check, subcommittee_index bounds, aggregation_bits non-empty, aggregator selection proof validity, aggregator subcommittee membership, and both selection proof and aggregate BLS signatures verified.

EDGE-RECV-MSG.target_component_interface: Message ID Derivation (Snappy decompression, SHA256 message ID computation)
EDGE-RECV-MSG.security_assumption: Messages must be correctly identified via domain-separated SHA256 hashing. Valid Snappy decompression uses MESSAGE_DOMAIN_VALID_SNAPPY; failed decompression uses MESSAGE_DOMAIN_INVALID_SNAPPY. This separation prevents message ID collisions between valid and invalid messages.

EDGE-RECEIVE-GOSSIP.target_component_interface: Attestation Gossip Validation (committee membership pre-cache verification)
EDGE-RECEIVE-GOSSIP.security_assumption: Committee membership must be verified BEFORE caching to prevent gossip mutation attacks. The committee_bits field (unsigned, outside signed data) must be cross-checked against actual committee assignments. This prevents attackers from modifying the committee index during gossip propagation.

EDGE-RECEIVE-NODES.target_component_interface: Discovery v5 NODES Response Handler (routing table update)
EDGE-RECEIVE-NODES.security_assumption: ENR records in NODES responses must be verified via their embedded signatures. Routing table updates must respect k-bucket limits (max 16 per bucket). Stale nodes must be evicted via liveness checks (PING). Response size limited to 16 result nodes per FINDNODE.

EDGE-RECEIVE-PACKET.target_component_interface: Discovery v5 Packet Processing (header unmasking, protocol verification, AES-GCM decryption)
EDGE-RECEIVE-PACKET.security_assumption: All incoming UDP packets must be: (1) header-unmasked using local node ID, (2) protocol ID and version verified, (3) message decrypted and authenticated via AES-GCM. Failed decryption triggers WHOAREYOU challenge for session establishment. Packet size must not exceed 1280 bytes.

EDGE-PEER-SENDS-GOSSIP.security_assumption: All gossip messages must be decompressed (snappy), size-validated (<= 10 MiB), message-ID computed, and content-validated per topic-specific rules (signature, slot, committee). REJECT messages penalize peer score.

EDGE-OVERSIZED-DROP.security_assumption: Oversized messages must be dropped and sender penalized via peer scoring. Snappy decompression must enforce size limit before full decompression to prevent memory exhaustion.

EDGE-CLOCK-CHECK.security_assumption: Message timestamps must be within 500ms tolerance. Messages from the future beyond this window must be IGNORED (not REJECTED) to avoid penalizing peers with slight clock drift.

EDGE-NEW-PEER.target_component_interface: libp2p connection handler with mandatory Status exchange
EDGE-NEW-PEER.security_assumption: Fork digest must be compared on connection. Mismatched fork digests require immediate disconnect. Status fields (finalized checkpoint, head) must not be blindly trusted for chain state decisions.

EDGE-READ-BLOCK-NUM.security_assumption: Block number used for difficulty calculation must be the canonical chain height. The bomb delay offset must be applied correctly (max(0, block_number - 9,000,000)). Integer underflow must be prevented via clamping to zero.

EDGE-VALIDATOR-SUBMIT-IL.security_assumption: Inclusion lists must be received before view freeze deadline. Equivocation (conflicting lists from same validator for same slot/root) must be detected and the validator's lists excluded from aggregation. Transactions must be deduplicated.

EDGE-BUILDER-CONSUMES-IL.security_assumption: Block builders must be constrained by separate enforcement mechanisms to actually include required transactions. The inclusion list store must correctly exclude equivocators from the transaction set.

EDGE-DAPP-SENDS-REQUEST.security_assumption: Request must be validated: asset type recognized, address checksum verified, chain ID validated. Image URLs must be checked for dangerous schemes (file://, http://) and SSRF (localhost/internal targets). Token similarity must be checked against known token lists for phishing. Response must be returned before user interaction to prevent fingerprinting.

EDGE-DESER-INPUT.security_assumption: Raw SSZ bytes must be deserialized with full validation before use in consensus logic. Deserialization failures must not cause crashes or undefined behavior. Memory allocation during deserialization must be bounded by declared type limits.

EDGE-USER-CALLS-CONTRACT.security_assumption: Standard transaction validation. BASEFEE value is derived from block context (not user input) so the opcode itself is safe, but contracts using BASEFEE for pricing must handle manipulation by block producers.

EDGE-START-BASE-LEN.security_assumption: Input parsing must handle: short input (zero-padding), zero-length fields, extremely large length values, modulus=0 edge case, gas cost must scale with operand complexity to prevent DoS.

EDGE-RECEIVE-DECODE.target_component_interface: Block header RLP decoding and validation pipeline
EDGE-RECEIVE-DECODE.security_assumption: Full block header validation required: parent hash, state root, transactions root, receipts root, withdrawals root, requests hash (SHA2-256), blob gas fields. Malformed RLP must be rejected.

EDGE-WITHDRAWALS-IN-BLOCK.target_component_interface: Engine API (withdrawal processing in block body)
EDGE-WITHDRAWALS-IN-BLOCK.security_assumption: Withdrawal data (index, validator_index, address, amount) comes from CL via authenticated Engine API. Content validation required: sequential indices, valid addresses, correct Gwei amounts. Withdrawals root must match header commitment.

EDGE-REQUESTS-HASH.target_component_interface: Engine API (EIP-7685 requests hash in block header)
EDGE-REQUESTS-HASH.security_assumption: Requests hash in header must be recomputed from block execution results and verified against the SHA2-256 commitment. CL provides the header but EL independently validates.

EDGE-GET-PAYLOAD.security_assumption: Payload and blobs_bundle from EL must be validated: KZG commitments must match blob data, blob count within MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK, execution_payload must be consistent with PayloadAttributes sent.

EDGE-CHECK-INDEX.security_assumption: Full sidecar validation required: blob index within bounds, KZG proof against commitment, Merkle inclusion proof linking commitment to block body, signed block header verification.

EDGE-SERVE.security_assumption: Serve only validated sidecars within retention window. Rate limit sync requests to prevent resource exhaustion.

EDGE-SUBMIT-BID.security_assumption: Full bid validation: BLS signature verification, builder active status in registry (verified via finalized checkpoint), balance >= bid_value + MIN_DEPOSIT_AMOUNT + pending_withdrawals, matching slot/parent_block_hash/randao, blob commitment count within limits, parent block fullness check.

EDGE-DELIVER-PAYLOAD.security_assumption: Payload envelope must match accepted bid: builder signature, payload consistency with bid commitments, blob data matching KZG commitments. PTC attestation determines builder payment.

EDGE-WALLET-INJECTION.security_assumption: No authentication possible for browser extensions. DApps must: freeze provider detail objects (Object.freeze), render SVG icons only via tag to prevent script execution, detect duplicate UUIDs as impersonation attempts, treat rdns as advisory only.

EDGE-CLIENT-SUBMIT.security_assumption: Full validation pipeline: JSON parse, RPC structure check, method lookup, parameter validation (0x-prefix, Quantity/Data encoding), hex decode, RLP decode, ECDSA signature verification, nonce/balance checks, fee structure validation (maxFee >= baseFee, priority <= maxFee), blob-specific checks (EIP-4844), init code size limits, authorization list validation (EIP-7702).

EDGE-PEER-SENDS-MESSAGE.security_assumption: Message type validation required: reject deprecated GetNodeData (0x0d) and NodeData (0x0e). Valid messages require full content validation (block headers, transactions). Snap protocol (GetByteCodes, GetTrieNodes) messages require separate validation.

EDGE-EXTERNAL-REQUEST.security_assumption: No built-in authentication. Security depends entirely on infrastructure-level protections (reverse proxy, firewall). Heavy endpoints (state queries, validator duties) are DoS vectors. Rate limiting recommended. Must not be exposed to public internet without security layers.

EDGE-PROOF-DELIVERED.security_assumption: Proof engine output crosses a trust boundary. Prover must validate proof content before signing with BLS. Domain separation via DOMAIN_EXECUTION_PROOF prevents cross-domain replay. Invalid proofs from a compromised engine could deceive stateless validators if signed by a whitelisted prover.

EDGE-RECV-CHECK-NONEMPTY.security_assumption: Full validation pipeline: non-empty proof data check, proof engine cryptographic verification, duplicate detection by request root + proof type, BLS signature verification against whitelisted prover public key with DOMAIN_EXECUTION_PROOF.

EDGE-NOTIFY-FORKCHOICE-UPDATED.target_component_interface: Engine API (forkchoiceUpdated with head_block_hash, safe_block_hash, finalized_block_hash)
EDGE-NOTIFY-FORKCHOICE-UPDATED.security_assumption: Engine API is JWT-authenticated. Fork choice updates must be processed atomically. Finalized payloads must be irreversibly persisted. Re-org protection via should_override_forkchoice_update requires all 8 conditions to be simultaneously true.

EDGE-FETCH-POW-BLOCK.security_assumption: Terminal PoW block must satisfy: total_difficulty >= TERMINAL_TOTAL_DIFFICULTY AND parent_total_difficulty < TERMINAL_TOTAL_DIFFICULTY. Or if TERMINAL_BLOCK_HASH is set, exact hash match required at correct epoch. Unavailable PoW data must trigger graceful degradation (deferred processing), not block rejection.

EDGE-COMPUTE-RESERVE.target_component_interface: Block header excess_blob_gas field (EIP-7918 reserve price)
EDGE-COMPUTE-RESERVE.security_assumption: Validators must independently recalculate excess_blob_gas using the modified formula with reserve price conditional logic. Header value must match recalculated value exactly. Both reserve mode (BLOB_BASE_COST * base_fee > GAS_PER_BLOB * blob_base_fee) and normal mode formulas must be correctly implemented.

EDGE-CLIENT-DISCOVERY-REQUEST.security_assumption: Method must not leak sensitive internal information. Rate limiting recommended to prevent enumeration abuse.

EDGE-RECEIVE-REQUEST.security_assumption: All RPC method calls must be validated. Reserved rpc.* namespace must be enforced.

EDGE-START-REQUEST.security_assumption: Provider must validate RequestArguments. Sensitive methods must require user authorization (error 4100). Request/response translation must not introduce injection.

EDGE-EXT-CLIENT-AUTH.security_assumption: Nonce must be verified for freshness/replay protection. Path permissions must be validated. User consent must be obtained before granting permissions.

EDGE-CALL-TO-PARSE.security_assumption: All length fields and operands must be parsed safely with zero-padding for short inputs. Gas cost must accurately reflect computational complexity to prevent DoS. Modulus-zero edge case must return zero.

EDGE-CALL-TO-DECODE1.security_assumption: Input points must be validated on curve. Coordinates must be checked against field modulus. Invalid inputs must raise OutOfGasError.

EDGE-MUL-DECODE-POINT.security_assumption: G1 point must be validated on curve. Scalar input is arbitrary 256-bit value. Gas cost (6000) must accurately reflect worst-case computation.

EDGE-VALIDATE-LEN.security_assumption: Input length must be divisible by 192. All G1/G2 points must be validated on curve AND in correct prime-order subgroup. Gas cost is linear in pair count. Subgroup check is critical for pairing security.

EDGE-PEER-RESPONDS-PARTIAL.security_assumption: Receipt count must match transaction count. Individual receipt size bounded by gas_limit/8. Total size bounded by block gas limit. Peer must be penalized for invalid data. Buffer sizes must be bounded to prevent memory exhaustion.

EDGE-PEER-REQUESTS.security_assumption: Request parameters must be validated. Response size must be bounded. firstBlockReceiptIndex must be within valid range.

EDGE-WALLET-INJECTS.security_assumption: DApp must verify provider identity. Multiple provider conflicts must be handled. Injected provider must not be modifiable by page scripts.

EDGE-USER-APPROVES.target_component_interface: Wallet consent UI (transaction signing, DID auth)
EDGE-USER-APPROVES.security_assumption: User must be shown clear, accurate information about what they are approving. Phishing-resistant UI required.

EDGE-BEACON-NODE-SIGNING-REQUEST.security_assumption: ALL signing requests MUST be checked against persistent slashing protection DB BEFORE signing. Block proposals must not duplicate slots. Attestations must not create double/surround votes. Far-future attestation check required (~6 hours threshold).

EDGE-BEACON-NODE-DUTIES.target_component_interface: Validator duty assignment and chain state API
EDGE-BEACON-NODE-DUTIES.security_assumption: Committee assignments and chain state from beacon node must be used carefully. Validator should cross-check critical data where possible.

EDGE-P2P-ATTESTATION.security_assumption: All received attestations must be fully validated (signature, committee membership, slot timing). Invalid attestations must be rejected.

EDGE-P2P-AGGREGATE.security_assumption: Aggregate proofs must verify selection proof, aggregator index, and aggregate signature. Must be rate-limited.

EDGE-ETH1-DEPOSITS.target_component_interface: ETH1 deposit data and block hash voting
EDGE-ETH1-DEPOSITS.security_assumption: Deposits must include valid Merkle proofs. ETH1 block candidates must satisfy follow distance and timestamp range. ETH1 endpoint could be compromised.

EDGE-REQUEST-BOOTSTRAP.security_assumption: Full nodes must serve data with valid Merkle proofs. Light clients must verify sync committee signatures and proofs. Updates must be ranked by is_better_update. Data withholding cannot be detected cryptographically.

EDGE-GENESIS-FETCHED.target_component_interface: Genesis configuration loader (HTTP fetch from yolonet.xyz)
EDGE-GENESIS-FETCHED.security_assumption: Genesis data integrity must be verified (e.g., hash comparison). No authentication specified; HTTPS assumed but not guaranteed.

EDGE-BOOTNODE-RESPONSE.target_component_interface: devp2p bootnode connection and peer discovery
EDGE-BOOTNODE-RESPONSE.security_assumption: Single bootnode is a centralization/availability risk. Peer list from bootnode must not be blindly trusted. Eclipse attack mitigation needed.

EDGE-STATS-OUTBOUND.security_assumption: Stats data should not leak sensitive node information. Connection should be optional and authenticated.

EDGE-DEVELOPER-DEPLOY.security_assumption: Experimental opcodes (EIP-2315 subroutines, EIP-2537 BLS) must be fully validated. Standard transaction validation applies.

EDGE-OPERATOR-INIT.security_assumption: Configuration inputs should be validated. Genesis file integrity should be verified against known hash.

EDGE-EXT-SUBMIT-TX.security_assumption: Full transaction validation required: signature s-value <= secp256k1n/2 (EIP-2), nonce < 2^64-1 (EIP-2681), gas limit <= 2^63-1 (EIP-7675/EIP-4803), sender is EOA not contract (EIP-3607/EIP-7675), valid transaction encoding. All calldata bytes contribute to gas cost at 15/60 gas per zero/non-zero byte (EIP-8007/EIP-7976).

EDGE-DAPP-TO-REQUEST.security_assumption: Transaction parameters (from, to, gas, gasPrice) must be validated. Method must be eth_sendTransaction (eth_sign prohibited). Read-only iframe requests filtered against 43-method whitelist. Browser same-origin policy assumed to enforce domain isolation.

EDGE-DAPP-TO-IFRAME.target_component_interface: EIP-107 Read-Only RPC via iframe postMessage
EDGE-DAPP-TO-IFRAME.security_assumption: RPC method must be in allowedMethods whitelist. JSON-RPC request must be parseable. Methods requiring account unlock are rejected.

EDGE-USER-AUTHORIZE-TX.security_assumption: User approval triggers 3-second account unlock window. Authorization popup must accurately display transaction details. UI spoofing must be prevented by the browser environment.

EDGE-PRECOMPILE-INPUT.security_assumption: All precompile inputs arrive via transactions from untrusted users. ALT_BN128: validate input length (64/128/192*n bytes), field element < modulus, point on curve, subgroup membership. BLS12-381: validate input length per operation type, field elements < BLS12 modulus, point on curve, subgroup check (point * curve_order == infinity). BLAKE2F: validate input exactly 213 bytes, final flag in {0,1}. Gas must be correctly charged before execution.

EDGE-CREATE-CALL-INPUT.security_assumption: All system opcode invocations originate from user transactions. Must validate: init code size <= MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE, address collision checks (EIP-7610 storage collision), call depth <= 1024, sender nonce < 2^64-1, sender balance >= endowment/value, static context restrictions for value transfer and SELFDESTRUCT. EIP-6780: SELFDESTRUCT only deletes contracts created in same transaction.

EDGE-DELEGATION-QUERY.security_assumption: EXTCODEADDRESS resolves only one level of delegation. Delegation target is NOT warmed (subsequent cold access costs apply). Sponsorship contracts must verify delegation target against whitelist. Delegation can change between transactions (TOCTOU risk).

EDGE-CL-TO-EL-ENGINE.security_assumption: JWT authentication verified. Execution payload content must still be validated: state transition correctness, gas accounting, transaction execution. EIP-8025 dual validation requires both ExecutionEngine and ProofEngine agreement.

EDGE-EL-REQUESTS-TO-CL.target_component_interface: EIP-7685 Request Processing via Engine API
EDGE-EL-REQUESTS-TO-CL.security_assumption: CL must independently validate all request contents. requests_hash (SHA256) in block header provides integrity commitment. Requests sorted by type ascending; empty requests excluded from hash. CL rejection does not affect EL block validity. Each request type has its own validation rules defined by subsequent EIPs.

EDGE-USER-SUBMIT-TX-RPC.security_assumption: Full transaction validation required: EIP-1559 fee fields (max_fee_per_gas >= base_fee), balance check (gas_limit * max_fee + value), EIP-155 chain ID verification, signature recovery, nonce check.

EDGE-USER-QUERY-RECEIPT-RPC.security_assumption: Query parameters must be validated. Bloom filter pre-filtering reduces I/O but false positives require full log verification. Rate limiting recommended to prevent resource exhaustion.

EDGE-DAPP-ABI-SUBMIT.security_assumption: ABI-to-data function selector validation is mandatory. Selector match does NOT guarantee ABI accuracy (4-byte collision possible). Wallet must clearly indicate ABI source is untrusted DApp.

EDGE-WALLET-SIGN-SUBMIT.security_assumption: EIP-155 chain ID must be extracted from v parameter and verified against network CHAIN_ID. Legacy v=27/28 transactions accepted for backward compatibility but lack cross-chain replay protection.

EDGE-P2P-TX-BROADCAST.security_assumption: All P2P-received transactions require identical validation as RPC-submitted transactions. Additionally, replay attack detection via EIP-155 chain ID check. Transactions with mismatched chain IDs must be rejected.

EDGE-P2P-BLOCK-GOSSIP.target_component_interface: devp2p block gossip / Engine API newPayload
EDGE-P2P-BLOCK-GOSSIP.security_assumption: Block validation must verify: EIP-1559 base fee matches calculation from parent, gas limit within ±1/1024 of parent, gas_used <= gas_limit, minimum gas limit >= 5000, all receipt status codes (EIP-658) correctly reflect execution outcomes.

EDGE-CL-PEER-GOSSIP.security_assumption: Fork digest verification required at connection time. During fork transitions (Fulu, EIP-6800, EIP-7892 BPO forks), peers with mismatched fork digests must be disconnected. ENR nfd field must be validated. All gossip messages require full consensus validation regardless of peer identity.

EDGE-PEER-TX-GOSSIP.security_assumption: Must validate transaction type byte (0-0x7f range), reject unknown types with peer disconnect (SHOULD), validate payload per type-specific rules. Must not process transactions for types not yet activated by fork block.

EDGE-PEER-BLOCK-GOSSIP.security_assumption: Full block validation required: header validation (gas, difficulty, PoW), ommer validation (max 2, age 1-6), transaction list validation (all types known and valid), state/receipt/tx root verification. Reject blocks with unknown transaction types.

EDGE-TX-SENDER-RPC.security_assumption: Full transaction validation: signature recovery, nonce match, balance >= gas*price + value, sender is EOA, gas available in block. For access list txs: validate access list entries. For blob txs: validate blob gas pricing (GAS_PER_BLOB * count * blob_base_fee).

EDGE-BLOCK-PRODUCER-SUBMIT.security_assumption: PoW validation (Ethash, mix digest, difficulty target), extraData validation during DAO fork range (blocks 1920000-1920009 must contain 'dao-hard-fork'), difficulty calculation with bomb delay. All state roots must be recomputed and verified.

EDGE-DAO-WITHDRAWAL.security_assumption: Must verify caller's DAO token balance via mainDAO contract before transferring proportional ether. Transfer failure must throw exception.

EDGE-VALIDATOR-ATTESTATION.security_assumption: Must validate committee_bits (within MAX_COMMITTEES_PER_SLOT), compute attesting indices from aggregation_bits, verify aggregate BLS signature. Detect conflicting attestations for slashing (penalty: effective_balance / 4096).

EDGE-EL-DEPOSIT-REQUESTS.security_assumption: Validate BLS deposit signature (is_valid_deposit_signature). Queue as PendingDeposit. Process at epoch boundary respecting: finality check (deposit slot must be finalized), MAX_PENDING_DEPOSITS_PER_EPOCH (16), activation churn limits. EL enforces MAX_DEPOSIT_REQUESTS_PER_PAYLOAD (8192).

EDGE-EL-WITHDRAWAL-REQUESTS.security_assumption: Validate source_address matches 0x01 withdrawal credentials, validator is active and not exiting. Amount=0 means full exit (compute exit epoch with churn). Non-zero amount queues PendingPartialWithdrawal. Max 16 per payload. Sweep max 8 per block.

EDGE-EL-CONSOLIDATION-REQUESTS.security_assumption: Validate source_address matches withdrawal credentials, both validators active, source != target, neither slashed. Same-validator triggers compounding switch (0x01 -> 0x02). Cross-validator queues PendingConsolidation. Max 2 per payload.

EDGE-PROVER-PROOF-SUBMIT.security_assumption: Three-stage validation: (1) prover_pubkey belongs to active validator, (2) BLS signature valid under DOMAIN_EXECUTION_PROOF, (3) proof cryptographically valid via proof_engine.verify_execution_proof. Reject at any failure stage. Max proof size 300 KiB.

EDGE-LIGHT-CLIENT-PROOF-REQ.target_component_interface: Merkle proof API (EIP-7916 progressive list proofs)
EDGE-LIGHT-CLIENT-PROOF-REQ.security_assumption: Proof generation must use stable generalized indices that are capacity-independent. Progressive tree structure must provide equivalent security to fixed-capacity merkle trees. Context-specific bounds enforcement required.

EDGE-KEY-ENCAPSULATION.security_assumption: Recipient public key should be verified via signerPubKey signature and optional trustedPubKey chain. Ephemeral keys must use CSRNG. ECDH shared secret derived correctly. AES-GCM encryption with HKDF-derived key/IV. Ephemeral keys must be securely destroyed after protocol completion for PFS.

EDGE-PEER-PROVIDES-BLOCK.security_assumption: Full block header and body validation required: block number, timestamp, gas limit, gas used, extra data, parent hash, difficulty (pre-merge), PoW (pre-merge). All data from peers is potentially malicious.

EDGE-PEER-REQUESTS-DATA.target_component_interface: devp2p historical data requests (GetBlockHeaders, GetBlockBodies, GetReceipts)
EDGE-PEER-REQUESTS-DATA.security_assumption: Requests must be bounded by HISTORY_PRUNE_EPOCHS window. Resource exhaustion prevention required for serving peers.

EDGE-WITHDRAWAL-REQUEST-SUBMIT.security_assumption: EL validates: input format (exactly 56 bytes), fee payment (msg.value >= current_fee). CL validates: source_address matches validator's withdrawal credentials. Dynamic fee mechanism must resist spam attacks.

EDGE-EXTERNAL-DATA-RESPONSE.target_component_interface: Out-of-band historical data retrieval (IPFS, Portal Network, indexers)
EDGE-EXTERNAL-DATA-RESPONSE.security_assumption: All historical data must be verified against known state roots or accumulator proofs. Data integrity cannot be assumed from the transport channel.

EDGE-PROOF-DELIVERY.security_assumption: API access must be restricted to authorized proof engines. Proof content must be cryptographically verified via verify_execution_proof(). Proof type must match requested ProofAttributes. Timeout handling required for missing/delayed proofs.

EDGE-MINER-BLOCK-SUBMISSION.security_assumption: Block difficulty must be independently recalculated using correct formula (including EIP-5133 bomb delay offset). Stated difficulty must match computed expected difficulty exactly.

EDGE-SSZ-CONTAINER-RECEIVED.security_assumption: Full schema validation required: non-empty container, max 256 fields, no trailing zeros in active_fields, field count matches active bits. Deserialized containers must have absent fields defaulted to zero. Merkle root must include active_fields mix-in.

EDGE-MERKLE-PROOF-SUBMISSION.security_assumption: Full proof path verification required. active_fields mix-in must be verified to prevent collision between absent fields and zero values. Gindex stability ensures backward compatibility but proofs from untrusted sources must be fully validated.

EDGE-SENT.target_component_interface: P2P gossip sync committee message handler
EDGE-SENT.security_assumption: All sync committee messages must be validated: (1) sender is in current sync committee, (2) signature is valid over the correct beacon block root, (3) message timing is within acceptable window per SYNC_MESSAGE_DUE_BPS.

EDGE-SUBMITTED.security_assumption: Aggregated contributions must be validated: (1) aggregation bits and signatures are consistent, (2) included individual messages are valid, (3) submission timing is within CONTRIBUTION_DUE_BPS window.

EDGE-USER-SUBMITS-CONSOLIDATION.security_assumption: Full validation required: (1) source address is 20 bytes, source/target pubkeys are 48 bytes each, (2) fee payment covers computed exponential fee, (3) queue has not exceeded 262,144 capacity limit. Requests exceeding capacity are discarded without refund.

EDGE-REQUEST-EXIT.security_assumption: Exit requests must be validated against validator registry. Weight-based churn limiting (256 ETH initial limit) must correctly handle partial exits and deferred processing. Large validator exits (up to 2048 ETH) must not bypass churn limits.

EDGE-PEER-INITIATE.security_assumption: Auth packet must be decryptable via ECIES with recipient's static key. Required fields (signature, initiator-pubk, initiator-nonce) must be present. Version mismatches and extra RLP elements are tolerated per EIP-8 but must not cause crashes or buffer overflows. Random padding (100-300 bytes) should use cryptographically secure randomness.

EDGE-PEER-HELLO.security_assumption: Hello packets parsed with forward-compatible tolerance. Version mismatches ignored. Capability advertisements must not be trusted without further protocol-level validation. Additional list elements and trailing data ignored safely.

EDGE-DISCOVERY-RECV.security_assumption: Packets must not exceed 1280 bytes. Unknown packet types silently discarded. Known types (ping/pong/findnode/neighbours) processed with tolerant RLP parsing. UDP source addresses are spoofable — no authentication at transport level.

EDGE-DAPP-REQUEST-PERMISSIONS.security_assumption: Permission system must: (1) correctly identify invoker origin without spoofing, (2) present clear consent UI resistant to clickjacking, (3) enforce caveat restrictions on method calls, (4) validate URLs against SSRF (scheme and port whitelisting), (5) filter permissions by invoker on query. Error 4001 returned on user rejection per EIP-1193.

EDGE-SIGNER-CONSTRUCT.security_assumption: Signed data MUST include TransactionType byte as first byte to ensure domain separation per EIP-2718. Signature verification must reject signatures where type byte is missing or mismatched, preventing cross-type signature reuse attacks.

EDGE-EXT-TO-RECEIVED.target_component_interface: P2P gossip / Beacon API light client endpoints
EDGE-EXT-TO-RECEIVED.security_assumption: All light client updates must be cryptographically verified: BLS aggregate signature verification over sync committee, Merkle branch verification for finality and execution payload proofs, slot ordering validation, and minimum participation threshold checks.

EDGE-UNTRUSTED-INPUT.security_assumption: Full cryptographic verification pipeline required: sync committee signature verification, finality Merkle proof verification, execution payload Merkle proof verification (Capella+). No update should be applied without passing all validation steps.

EDGE-BOOTSTRAP-TO-INIT.target_component_interface: Light client bootstrap initialization (trusted block root input)
EDGE-BOOTSTRAP-TO-INIT.security_assumption: The trusted block root MUST correspond to a canonical chain block. If this root is compromised, all subsequent light client validation is compromised. This is the root of trust for the entire light client protocol. Users must obtain this via reliable out-of-band channels.

EDGE-PROPOSER-SUBMITS.security_assumption: Block proposer data must be validated through complete consensus validation pipeline: slot verification, proposer eligibility, execution payload validity via Engine API, and (post-EIP-6800) Verkle witness structural and cryptographic verification.

EDGE-ENGINE-VERIFY.security_assumption: The CL trusts the EL to correctly verify execution payloads and return accurate results. JWT authenticates the channel. The CL cannot independently re-verify execution-layer state transitions. A compromised EL would compromise CL's view of execution validity.

EDGE-HEADER-FROM-PEER.security_assumption: Block difficulty must be independently recalculated using the difficulty formula with fork-adjusted block numbers (post-Muir Glacier: max(0, block.number - 9,000,000)). Stated difficulty in headers cannot be trusted.

EDGE-P2P-DAS-COLUMNS.security_assumption: Column sidecar data must be verified against KZG commitments from the beacon block. Peers may serve invalid columns or withhold data. Custody group assignments must be independently computed. ENR custody claims cannot be trusted without verification.

EDGE-MEV-RELAY-PAYLOAD.target_component_interface: MEV-Boost relay API / External builder API
EDGE-MEV-RELAY-PAYLOAD.security_assumption: Execution payloads from external builders via MEV-Boost relays must be fully validated through the same pipeline as locally-built payloads. No trust should be placed in relay assertions about payload validity or value. Relay availability cannot be guaranteed.

EDGE-BLOCK-RECEIVED.security_assumption: Block must pass signature verification, slot validation, parent existence check, and state transition validation before being accepted into fork choice. Equivocating proposers must be detected.

EDGE-PTC-VOTE.security_assumption: PTC attestations must verify: validator is in assigned PTC committee for the slot, attestation signature is valid, and validator index maps correctly to ptc_vote boolean vector. Quorum threshold (>256/512) required before payload timeliness is accepted.

EDGE-PAYLOAD-RECEIVED.security_assumption: Execution payload envelope must be verified for data availability (blob KZG commitments). JWT authentication validates the channel but payload content integrity must be checked independently. Payload must correspond to a known block.

EDGE-USER-DEPLOY.security_assumption: Full transaction validation required: signature verification, nonce check, gas limit validation, init code execution, and returned bytecode size check (<=24576 bytes per EIP-170). Out-of-gas on size violation.

EDGE-BLOCK-RECEIVED-P2P.security_assumption: Blocks from P2P must be fully validated: header verification, transaction execution, state root comparison, contract size limits enforcement. Size-bounded verification time guaranteed by EIP-170.

EDGE-RPC-REQUEST.security_assumption: All RPC inputs must be validated: address format, storage key format, block identifier resolution, parameter bounds. Rate limiting and request size limits should prevent DoS. Storage key count for eth_getProof should be bounded.

EDGE-UNTRUSTED-PROOF-RESPONSE.security_assumption: Proof data from untrusted RPC providers must be cryptographically verified against a trusted stateRoot. Each node in accountProof and storageProof must be hashed and path-validated. Non-existence proofs must show divergence or empty branch.

EDGE-ENGINE-API-CL-TO-EL.security_assumption: JWT authentication required on the channel. Payload content must be fully validated: transaction execution, state root computation, gas accounting, receipt verification. The EL must not trust CL-provided execution data without independent verification.

EDGE-EVM-CALL-PAIRING.security_assumption: Input must be validated: length divisible by 192, G1 coordinates < p and on curve (or zero point), G2 coordinates valid in F_p² with correct subgroup order q. Gas cost (80000*k + 100000) must be pre-deducted. Invalid input must revert consuming all gas.

EDGE-TRUSTED-HEADER.target_component_interface: Block header sync (light client protocol / beacon chain)
EDGE-TRUSTED-HEADER.security_assumption: Block headers are trusted based on consensus mechanism (PoS finality). The stateRoot in the header serves as the cryptographic trust anchor. Light client sync protocol must verify committee signatures and finality checkpoints.

EDGE-CL-ENGINE-API-FORK-ACTIVATION.security_assumption: EL must independently validate fork activation criteria (block number/timestamp). JWT authentication ensures channel integrity but fork parameters must be verified against local configuration.

EDGE-USER-ESTIMATE-MANA.security_assumption: Input parameters must be validated to prevent resource exhaustion during estimation. Malformed transaction parameters should be rejected before simulation.

EDGE-PEER-BLOCK-DELIVERY.security_assumption: Full block validation required: header validation, transaction execution, state root verification, receipt root verification. Malformed blocks must be rejected without crashing.

EDGE-STAKER-DEPOSIT-TX.security_assumption: Deposit logs must be filtered by exact contract address (0x00000000219ab540356cbb839cbe05303d7705fa) and event signature hash. Data must be exactly 576 bytes. Field parsing is structural; cryptographic validation deferred to CL.

EDGE-DEPOSIT-DOS-ATTACK.security_assumption: Economic cost of deposit spam (~1000 ETH per second of delay) provides primary defense. Maximum 8192 deposits per payload caps worst-case processing. BLS signature verification timing must be bounded.

EDGE-VALIDATOR-INDEX-REUSE.security_assumption: Index reuse must atomically clear equivocation history via on_reused_index(). Attacker must not be able to time deposits to receive specific indices. is_reusable_validator() must enforce sufficient cooldown period.

EDGE-LC-GOSSIP-FINALITY.security_assumption: Fork version must be validated before SSZ deserialization. Light client updates must be verified against sync committee signatures. Rate limiting via gossipsub scoring assumed.

EDGE-LC-REQRESP-BOOTSTRAP.security_assumption: Bootstrap data must be validated against known checkpoint. Fork-versioned SSZ type must match expected fork version for the requested slot. Malformed responses must be rejected.

EDGE-SSZ-DESERIALIZATION-BOUNDARY.target_component_interface: SSZ deserialization for light client messages
EDGE-SSZ-DESERIALIZATION-BOUNDARY.security_assumption: Fork version must be determined from slot/epoch before selecting SSZ type. Deserialization with wrong type must fail safely without crashes or memory corruption. Messages at genesis fork version must be rejected.

EDGE-WS-CHECKPOINT-SYNC.security_assumption: Checkpoint root and epoch must be validated against chain state. Node must verify it is within the weak subjectivity period. If outside WS period, node must halt and require operator intervention for fresh checkpoint.

EDGE-LONG-RANGE-ATTACK-CHAIN.security_assumption: Conflicting chains must be rejected if they disagree with a valid WS checkpoint within the WS period. Node must track WS period expiry and refuse to sync if exceeded.

EDGE-EB-GRINDING-ATTACK.security_assumption: Effective balances must be frozen at epoch N - MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD - 1 before RANDAO for epoch N is known. Proposer schedule stored in state must be immutable once computed. Lookahead vector must be initialized correctly at fork activation.

EDGE-RANDAO-OBSERVATION.target_component_interface: RANDAO seed retrieval for proposer computation
EDGE-RANDAO-OBSERVATION.security_assumption: RANDAO values must be unpredictable at the time effective balances are set. MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD provides the temporal separation. If RANDAO prediction advances, the security margin must be re-evaluated.

EDGE-BLS-AGGREGATE-VERIFY.security_assumption: All public keys must pass KeyValidate before aggregation. Empty pubkey sets must only accept G2 point at infinity as valid signature. FastAggregateVerify must be used for non-empty sets. BLS library must conform to IETF draft v4.

EDGE-DEPOSITOR-INDEX-REUSE.security_assumption: Index reuse requires: (1) current_epoch > withdrawable_epoch + SAFE_EPOCHS_TO_REUSE_INDEX (65536), (2) balance == 0. Iteration order must be deterministic (ascending index). Overwriting validator record must clear all equivocation history.

EDGE-HISTORICAL-INDEX-QUERY.target_component_interface: Beacon API validator queries by index
EDGE-HISTORICAL-INDEX-QUERY.security_assumption: External systems must be aware that validator index identity can change after reuse. APIs should expose pubkey changes. The 0.8-year time-lock is assumed sufficient for all historical references to become stale.

EDGE-MODEXP-PRECOMPILE-CALL.security_assumption: Gas cost must accurately reflect computation: minimum floor of 500 gas, multiplication complexity based on operand size with minimum 32-byte assumption, iteration count with 16x multiplier for large exponents. Malformed inputs must fail with all gas consumed.

EDGE-WHISK-PROOF-VALIDATION.security_assumption: Shuffle proof must validate 124-tracker permutation via Curdleproofs ZK scheme. Opening proof must verify knowledge of secret k. k_commitment must be unique across all validators. First-time registration must verify tracker.r_G != BLS_G1_GENERATOR. All proof failures must cause block rejection.

EDGE-ETH66-MESSAGE-RECEPTION.security_assumption: RLP structure must be validated: [request_id, [payload]] format with valid 64-bit request_id. Response correlation must handle duplicate IDs safely. Pending request tracking must have timeouts to prevent memory exhaustion from request flooding.

EDGE-LC-CROSS-FORK-DATA.security_assumption: Pre-Capella data must be validated before local conversion. Empty ExecutionPayloadHeader and ExecutionBranch defaults used during upgrade must not pass validation as real execution data. Upgrade functions should guard against double-application.
